name: How long does the punch list and closeout process take?
description: The punch list and closeout duration varies by project complexity, typically taking from a few days to several weeks for landscape projects.

mainEntity.name: How long does the punch list and closeout process take?

acceptedAnswer.text: The duration of the punch list and closeout process varies depending on the project's size, complexity, and the number of outstanding items. For residential landscape projects, it can range from a few days to several weeks. Our goal is efficient completion, working diligently to address items swiftly while maintaining quality standards. We communicate timelines clearly during this phase.
